description: The temperature probe froze on the 12.0 C setpoint after the first nine trips, so 952 of 960 trips report exactly 12.0: a column that looks like proof but carries no information. value_counts() or nunique() on cargo_temp_c shows it at once, and its standard deviation is almost zero while rejections vary widely. A flatlined sensor is one of the commonest failures in real telemetry, and zero-variance columns are common enough that scikit-learn ships VarianceThreshold just to drop them. The company and its data are fictional.
hints: A column that never changes can't explain anything. Check how many distinct values each column has.
Look at the temperature column's spread with value_counts() or its standard deviation.
cargo_temp_c is exactly 12.0 on 952 of 960 trips: the probe was stuck on the setpoint.
